---
title: "Stage 1 — Demographic models"
output: html_document

params:
  config_file: "config/madagascar.yml"
  mode: "fit"                # reuse | fit
  verbose: false

---

## Run Stage 1

```{r setup, message=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
source(file.path("R", "stage1_workflow.R"))
rmd_options <- project_rmd_params("1_demographic_models.Rmd")
configured <- rmd_project_config(rmd_options, "stage1")
rmd_params <- configured$params
demography_paths <- demography_model_paths()
config <- stage1_config(rmd_params, demography_paths$project)
stage1_result <- run_stage1(config, demography_paths)
```

## Summary

```{r summary, echo=FALSE}
print(stage1_result$calibration_summary)
print(stage1_result$bird_diet_counts)
cat(
  "Stage 1 complete\n",
  "Mode: ", stage1_result$action, "\n",
  "Posterior draws per model: ", stage1_result$posterior_draws_per_model, "\n",
  "Bird model branches: ", paste(stage1_result$bird_model_branches, collapse = ", "), "\n",
  "Data directory: ", config$paths$data_dir, "\n",
  "Figure directory: ", config$paths$figure_dir, "\n",
  "Elapsed seconds: ", sprintf("%.1f", stage1_result$elapsed_seconds), "\n",
  sep = ""
)
for (path in stage1_result$figure_files) {
  if (file.exists(path)) print(knitr::include_graphics(path))
}
```
